description: Sri Lanka Anti-Doping Agency - Notify the Anti-Doping (Prohibited list) Regulation, No. 03 of 2017 under Convention Against Doping in Sports Act (38/2013) effective from 01.01.2018
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Sports under the Convention against Doping in Sports Act, No. 33 of 2013. It establishes the prohibited list of substances and methods in sports, which constitutes regulatory framework and compliance requirements. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it creates binding rules under statutory authority rather than dealing with government personnel, organizational changes, or other specialized categories.
